5.6.44 Rte_IsOutOfRange Purpose: Provide access to the out-of-range information for a member of an ImplementationDataType of category STRUCTURE for a given Vari- ableDataProtoType of a port. Signature: [SWS_Rte_04684] Signature of Rte_IsOutOfRange ⌈ boolean Rte_IsOutOfRange_

__(void) Where

is the shortName of the port and is the shortName of the VariableDataPrototype and is the shortName of the ImplementationDataTypeElement inside the flattened Imple- mentationDataType of type STRUCTURE.⌋ Existence: [SWS_Rte_04685] Existance of Rte_IsOutOfRange ⌈An Rte_- IsOutOfRange API shall be generated for an Implementation- DataTypeElement of an ImplementationDataType for the VariableDataPrototype where its outOfRangeBitfieldEr- rorsEnabled is set to true.⌋ Description: The Rte_IsOutOfRange API takes a concrete variable as input by reference (e.g. returned data and comErrorInfo of Rte_Read). The return value is used to indicate whether the member is out-of- range for the VariableDataPrototype of the port

. Return Value: • [SWS_Rte_04686] TRUE returned by Rte_IsOutOfRange ⌈TRUE – The member is out of range.⌋ • [SWS_Rte_04687] FALSE returned by Rte_IsOutOfRange ⌈FALSE – The member is not out of range.⌋ Notes: None.
